audience: sales teams that manage deals, contacts and follow-up tasks in RD Station CRM

useCases.title: Review deals by pipeline stage
useCases.text: List the pipelines and their stages, then list the deals and open one deal in full.

useCases.title: Move a deal to another stage
useCases.text: Read the deal, then update only the fields you name, such as its stage or closing date.

useCases.title: Plan follow-up tasks
useCases.text: List the tasks by done state, then create a follow-up call task on a deal.

useCases.title: Review the activity history
useCases.text: List the activities of a date range, and the companies in the CRM account.

useCases.title: Add a contact from a new lead
useCases.text: Look up the custom field ids, create the contact, and update its fields later.
